name: CP Plus 2MP Full HD Smart WiFi CCTV Camera
reviews: Very good camera for the price. Setup was easy.
Night vision is excellent, can see clearly in dark.
Best budget camera available in India right now.
Stopped connecting to WiFi after 2 months. Very disappointed.
Picture quality is sharp and clear during daytime.
Mobile app works smoothly. Live view is great.
Cheap build quality but works fine for indoor use.

name: Realme TechLife Cam360 4MP Outdoor Security Camera
reviews: Excellent outdoor camera. Survived heavy rain.
4MP clarity is amazing, can read number plates clearly.
360 degree rotation is very smooth.
WiFi range could be better, drops at 15 meters.
Night vision is outstanding even in complete darkness.
Worth every rupee. Highly recommended for outdoor.
Two way audio is very useful, sound quality is clear.

name: Tapo C200 Pan/Tilt Home Security WiFi Camera
reviews: Best camera I have ever bought. Pan tilt is amazing.
Motion tracking works perfectly, follows movement automatically.
Tapo app is very user friendly and reliable.
Setup took only 5 minutes. Very easy for beginners.
Night vision range is around 9 meters, which is good.
Build quality is premium compared to price.
Occasional lag in live view but overall great product.

name: Hikvision DS-2CD1143G2-I 4MP AcuSense Outdoor Camera
reviews: Professional grade camera at this price is unbelievable.
AI detection reduces false alerts significantly.
Wired connection means zero connectivity issues.
Hikvision is the best brand for security cameras globally.
Installation needs professional help, not plug and play.
H.265 compression saves a lot of storage space.
Night vision is infrared based, works perfectly in zero light.

name: Mi Home Security Camera Basic 1080p
reviews: Very affordable and works decently for basic monitoring.
Mi Home app integration is seamless.
Had connectivity issues after firmware update.
For this price you cannot expect much but it delivers basics.
Night vision is average, only works up to 5 meters.
Build feels cheap but works for the price.
Stopped working completely after 4 months.

name: Godrej Solus Premium 3MP Outdoor Bullet Camera
reviews: Godrej brand gives confidence in quality and after sales.
30 meter night vision range is excellent for outdoor.
Wired connection is rock solid, no drops ever.
Wide angle lens covers large area, reduced cameras needed.
Setup was straightforward with the included manual.
Bit expensive compared to Chinese brands but reliability is worth it.
Customer support was helpful when I had a query.

name: ASUS VivoBook 15 Intel Core i5 12th Gen Laptop
reviews: Great laptop for office and college work. Very fast.
Battery life is outstanding, lasts all day easily.
Build quality is premium, feels solid in hands.
Display is bright and colors are vibrant.
Runs all office applications smoothly without heating.
Value for money is excellent at this price point.
Fan noise is a bit loud during heavy tasks.

name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 AMD Ryzen 5 5500U Laptop
reviews: Best budget laptop for students. No compromise on performance.
Ryzen 5 handles everything including light gaming.
Screen quality is decent for the price.
Keyboard is comfortable for long typing sessions.
Build feels a bit plasticky but acceptable for budget.
Heats up a bit under gaming loads.
Excellent for college and coding work.

name: HP Pavilion 15 Intel Core i7 12th Gen Gaming Laptop
reviews: Excellent performance for gaming and heavy work.
16GB RAM handles multitasking like a pro.
Display quality is brilliant, IPS panel is stunning.
MX550 GPU handles older games very well at medium settings.
Build quality is solid and premium feel.
Battery drains fast during gaming, keep charger handy.
Worth every rupee for the performance you get.

name: MacBook Air M2 13 inch 8GB 256GB
reviews: Best laptop ever made. M2 performance is unbelievable.
Battery lasts 18 hours easily on normal usage.
Display is absolutely stunning, best in class.
Silent operation, no fan noise at all ever.
macOS ecosystem is seamless if you have iPhone.
256GB storage feels a bit less after a year of use.
Premium build quality justifies every rupee of the price.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 5G 8GB 128GB
reviews: Fastest Android phone I have ever used. Lightning quick.
Camera quality is exceptional, AI processing is amazing.
Display is the best on any Android phone.
Battery life improved with 8 Gen 3, lasts full day.
Galaxy AI features are genuinely useful not gimmicky.
Heats slightly during intensive gaming sessions.
Build quality is premium and feels very solid.

name: Realme 12 Pro Plus 5G 12GB 256GB
reviews: Best mid-range phone for camera lovers. Periscope is great.
12GB RAM keeps everything running super smooth.
67W charging fills up the phone in under an hour.
Display quality punches above its price range.
Camera zoom quality is outstanding at this price.
Gaming performance is excellent for a mid ranger.
Occasional heating issue during long gaming sessions.

name: iQOO Neo 9 Pro 5G 8GB 128GB
reviews: Absolute beast of a phone at this price. Gaming king.
120W charging is insane, full charge in 25 minutes.
144Hz display is buttery smooth for gaming.
Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 handles anything you throw at it.
iQOO software is clean with no bloatware.
Camera is good but not the best in this segment.
Battery life is excellent, easily lasts the full day.

name: Poco M6 Pro 5G 6GB 128GB
reviews: Best budget 5G phone under 15000 in India.
Performance is smooth for daily tasks and social media.
Battery life is solid, lasts almost two days.
Camera is decent for the price, good in daylight.
Build quality is good, feels premium for budget.
18W charging is slow compared to competitors.
Great value for money if you want basic 5G connectivity.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
reviews: Best noise cancellation headphones money can buy.
Sound quality is absolutely phenomenal and rich.
30 hour battery is accurate, very long lasting.
Very comfortable for hours of continuous use.
Call quality is crystal clear with excellent mics.
Expensive but worth every single rupee spent.
Multipoint connection between phone and laptop is seamless.

name: boAt Rockerz 450 Pro Bluetooth Headphones
reviews: Best budget headphones in India. Great bass.
70 hours battery is insane for the price.
Sound is bass heavy which is great for music.
Build quality is decent for a budget product.
Mic quality is average during calls.
Foldable design makes it very portable.
Gets a bit uncomfortable after 2-3 hours of use.

name: JBL Tune 770NC Wireless ANC Headphones
reviews: Excellent ANC at this mid-range price point.
70 hours battery with ANC on is impressive.
JBL sound signature is punchy and fun to listen to.
Comfortable padding, great for long listening sessions.
Ambient mode is very useful outdoors.
ANC is not as strong as Sony XM5 but good for the price.
Foldable and compact design is great for travel.

name: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless Headphones
reviews: Sennheiser sound quality is unmatched, very balanced and detailed.
60 hours battery is exceptional for premium headphones.
ANC performance is excellent, blocks all ambient noise.
Most comfortable headphones I have worn for hours.
Sound stage is wide and immersive, music feels live.
App customisation is great for EQ tweaking.
Slightly expensive but a true audiophile choice.

name: Apple Watch Series 9 GPS 41mm
reviews: Best smartwatch for iPhone users, seamless integration.
Health tracking features are very accurate and reliable.
Build quality and display are absolutely premium.
ECG and blood oxygen features are genuinely useful.
Battery lasts about 18 hours, needs daily charging.
Only works with iPhone which is a major limitation.
Double tap gesture is a game changer for convenience.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 44mm Bluetooth
reviews: Best Android smartwatch in the market right now.
Blood pressure monitoring is surprisingly accurate.
AMOLED display is vivid and easy to read outdoors.
Works perfectly with Samsung and non-Samsung Androids.
Battery lasts about 40 hours which is acceptable.
Sleep tracking is very detailed and useful.
Rotating bezel was removed which is slightly disappointing.

name: Noise ColorFit Ultra 3 Smartwatch
reviews: Best budget smartwatch in India for the features offered.
7 day battery is very convenient, charge once a week.
AMOLED display looks premium for the price.
Fitness tracking is accurate enough for daily use.
GPS is a bit slow to lock but works fine.
Heart rate sensor is reasonably accurate.
Build quality is good, feels durable for a budget watch.
